tasks.description: Repo: memev. The gap: src/cli/main.mjs does not dispatch the work command, and runWork has no production way to open the project store. This task adds the dispatch (case 'work' in main.mjs, which calls runWork from src/cli/work.mjs) and one port module, src/cli/work-store.mjs, that exports openStore and returns the real project store of the vault at the resolved root. No test double is used in a production path: a test injects its own store only through the same port argument that main.mjs fills with openStore. src/cli/work.mjs is owned by SO-A-03 and is not changed here; if runWork needs a port argument, that change is made in SO-A-03 first.

title: PG-19.1 memev work command wired to runWork with a production openStore (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP19 in memev: wire the work command into the CLI and give runWork a production openStore. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. WP19 is a new gap found after the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 and decided under owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026; it is not in docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/. Depends on contracts: SO-A-03 (defines runWork and memev work status; signed fold contract, cited by id), SO-1.01 (the store, the state machine and the coordinator as one authority). Searched before drafting: no spec under contracts/*/specs names runWork or openStore, and none has a criterion for the work dispatch in src/cli/main.mjs; SO-A-01 lists main.mjs in its scope for memev work prefer only. Boundary with SO-08-B: it stays recovery and control under WP08-02; this contract adds no recovery or control command, only the dispatch, the port and the tests. Boundary with SO-A-03: src/cli/work.mjs and runWork belong to it; this contract changes neither. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
